title: The Wild Garden
premise: Paloma Vane, a temple scribe bound by debt to the silent valley of Vell, discovers their own dormant gift the same night the crown's witch-hunters arrive at the valley's edge. Fleeing with a wounded stranger named Ivo, who carries a sealed relic that could reignite the ancient war between gifted and ungifted, Paloma must choose between loyalty to the temple family that raised them and the truth about what magic really is. As the hunt closes in and Ivo's secret begins to kill him, Paloma learns the valley's 'protection' was never mercy but a cage built on a lie. In the end, Paloma breaks the relic open, releasing magic back into the world at terrible cost — losing the valley forever but gaining a found family willing to face what comes next.
about_author: Casper Galloway is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing forbidden manuscripts before turning to fiction. They write fantasy about people caught between institutions and their own hearts.

chapters.title: Ink That Won't Dry
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. In the temple at Vell, Paloma copies ledgers to work off their debt, hiding small impossible things — ink that moves, candles that relight themselves. When a fevered stranger collapses at the gate clutching a sealed box, Paloma's suppressed gift flares visibly for the first time. Emotional beat: longing curdling into fear as Paloma realizes they can no longer hide.

chapters.title: The Crown's Long Shadow
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The stranger, Ivo, wakes and reveals he is being hunted for carrying the Emberbox, a relic from the old war. Witch-hunters have reached the valley passes — a place magic supposedly cannot follow. The temple elders vote to surrender both strangers to buy peace. Emotional beat: dread and betrayal as sanctuary becomes a trap.

chapters.title: Debt Paid in Blood
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. The elder who raised Paloma offers to erase their debt if they hand over Ivo. Torn, Paloma instead steals the temple's travel seals and flees with Ivo through the night markets. A hunter's arrow finds Ivo's shoulder; the wound refuses to heal. Emotional beat: guilt and exhilaration entwined — Paloma's first act of true choice.

chapters.title: Where Magic Cannot Follow
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Crossing the valley border, they discover the truth: the valley doesn't block magic, it devours it, feeding on the gifted for generations. Paloma feels the land pulling at their gift like leeches. Ivo's infection worsens — the Emberbox is keeping him alive. Emotional beat: horror at learning home was a predator all along.

chapters.title: The Cartographer's Daughter
chapters.summary: New POV: Sefa, a smuggler-cartographer who once loved someone the crown burned. She agrees to guide them toward the Ashen Conclave, rumored keepers of the relic's origin, in exchange for passage maps hidden inside the Emberbox's casing. Emotional beat: cautious hope — the first fragile threads of found family.

chapters.title: What the Hunters Sing
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Captured briefly by hunters, Ivo learns their captain, Maren Voss, isn't a zealot — she believes releasing the Emberbox will reignite the war that killed her children. He escapes but understands her, which is worse. Meanwhile Sefa teaches Paloma to trust their gift deliberately. Emotional beat: empathy across enemy lines; the hunt gains a human face.

chapters.title: The Ashen Conclave
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. The Conclave reveals the Emberbox holds the last seed of wild magic, and only a debt-bound soul — someone who has given everything and chosen nothing — can open it safely. Paloma qualifies perfectly. But opening it will burn the valley's devouring heart out, destroying everything and everyone still inside. Emotional beat: the weight of being 'chosen' as a kind of erasure.

chapters.title: Everything We Buried
chapters.summary: Sefa's POV. Maren's hunters storm the Conclave; Sefa dies holding the pass so the others can flee, her last words asking them to make her maps mean something. Grief fractures the group — Ivo wants to hide the Box forever, Paloma wants to open it. Emotional beat: devastating loss that hardens resolve into purpose.

chapters.title: The Price of Survival
chapters.summary: Climax, dual POV. Cornered above the valley rim, Paloma opens the Emberbox as Maren watches — not fighting, but witnessing. Wild magic floods the world; the valley's hunger dies screaming. Ivo nearly dies anchoring the release, saved by Paloma channeling their gift through their bond. Maren lowers her weapon, choosing truth over orders. Emotional beat: sacrifice transmuted into rebirth.

chapters.title: A Garden Gone Wild
chapters.summary: Paloma's POV. Weeks later, magic seeps into ordinary soil — flowers bloom wrong and wonderful. The valley survivors, freed from the devouring land, must learn to live among the gifted. Paloma, debt-free and rootless by choice, plants a garden with Ivo and Maren's defected hunters. Emotional beat: quiet, earned hope — family is what you tend, not where you're kept.
